editorial:
Ever wondered what happened to that one person you loved in college but lost touch with? You will feel that exact feeling watching this movie. It follows Seung-min, a shy architecture student, and Seo-yeon, a bright music student. They fall for each other in a sweet, awkward way that feels totally real. The story jumps back and forth between their young, clumsy love and their adult lives when they meet again years later. It has a cozy, nostalgic vibe that makes you want to look through your own old photos and remember your first crush.

The acting is great because it feels like you are watching real people, not movie stars. While the pace is slow and steady, it keeps you hooked because you really want to know why they broke up. If you love stories about fate and second chances, you need to see this.
endingExplained: After rebuilding the house, you find out that the two characters never really stopped caring for each other. They finally talk about the misunderstanding from their youth that drove them apart. While they do not end up in a typical fairy tale marriage right away, they find peace with their past. They realize that their first love shaped who they are today, and they move forward in their lives with a smile and a clean heart.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about first love and second chances.
